name: request_callback
description: Use when the staff member needs more than a minute or two to check and agrees to be called back. After it returns, say you will call back in about that many minutes, thank them, and end the call.

attempt_id.description: Internal attempt reference from the call context. Filled in automatically; never ask for it and never say it.

minutes.description: How many minutes from now to call back, as digits, for example 5.

contact_person.description: Whom to ask for on the callback, if given.

to_number.description: The number you called. Filled in automatically; never ask for it.
